honestCaveats: The sweep completed and reached ALL 33 entries (27 lanes + 6 gates) in 1476338 ms: 21 pass / 0 unavailable / 12 fail, exit 1. MEASURED root cause of all 12 reds: the launching environment has NO credential — `bash -c 'echo ${DEEPSEEK_API_KEY:-ABSENT}'` and `bash -lc …` both print ABSENT (the T-58 fact) — so every lane that boots a live headless model aborts with `dsh: MISSING_CREDENTIAL: llm-deepseek: no API key for provider route "deepseek-official"; store DEEPSEEK_API_KEY through the credentials service (the web Models page writes it), or export DEEPSEEK_API_KEY in the launching environment`. That line was found in EVERY failing lane's own evidence directory (agent-teams-adopt, agent-teams-dispatch, codegraph-smoke, dual-track-smoke, mcp-call, memory-smoke, plan-c-smoke, tool-output-validation, ultrawork-smoke, vision-smoke, workmate-library, workmate-team-member), so they are the T-58 credential class owned by t17 — NOT runner defects and NOT lane assertion failures. agent-teams-adopt additionally carries its pre-existing `webRoute 401 unauthorized`. Sanity cross-check: t3's earlier batch, run with the key present, had these same lanes PASS. This is an incremental-write run: result.json/output.log were written after every entry, so an interrupted run still leaves usable evidence.

The sweep's per-lane execution used the runner as of 01:19:11Z; the only later edits were CLI flag parsing (both `--flag=value` and `--flag value`) plus a self-test pin for that spelling — no lane-execution or classification change. Proof that the FINAL artifact was exercised inside the same suite: the `qa-lane-drift` (61 ms) and `qa-runner-self-test` (1338 ms) gates each spawn a fresh `node scripts/run-qa-lanes.mjs` and both PASSED at the end of the sweep.

The 17 lanes outside the `all` suite are pre-existing membership, now EXPLICIT (each with an outsideSuites reason): 7 DSH-TUI edition lanes (need dsh-tui/tmux/a TUI sandbox profile), 6 team-watchdog lanes (in-process over the built dists; the watchdog subsystem is being rewritten this wave), 3 live fix lanes (agent-teams-messaging, explicit-team-trigger, readonly-deny) and the extension-isolation shared helper (no lane mode). They are runnable on demand via --only; expanding the sweep is a separate decision, deliberately not taken mid-wave.

Carry-forward (out of t15 scope): `test:qa` and `test:qa:strict` are still abort-on-first-failure for-loops over the self-test glob — that is why the vendor-lock red HID the other 43 self-tests until they were measured individually; the same runner could drive them with a selfTest mode.
